summary: Hyena Muay Thai is a Muay Thai gym in Hua Hin offering drop-in group sessions, session packs, memberships and private training with head trainer Kru Louis.

facts.label: Drop-in
facts.value: 350 baht per group session, first session free

facts.label: Private session
facts.value: 1,000 baht per one-to-one session, sixth free when booking five
facts.quote: One-to-one with Kru Louis at ฿1,000 a session

facts.label: Monthly membership
facts.value: 1 month: 7,000 baht once daily, 10,000 baht unlimited

facts.label: Schedule
facts.value: Morning 08:00 to 11:00 and afternoon 16:30 to 19:00, Monday to Saturday
facts.quote: Morning training Mon – Sat 08:00 – 11:00 Afternoon training Mon – Sat 16:30 – 19:00

facts.label: Levels
facts.quote: Never thrown a kick? Start here.

facts.label: Head trainer
facts.quote: Louis leads every session at Hyena.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Poon Suk Rd, Soi Selakham, Hua Hin
